You are adding or updating a JBS Construction portfolio project.

Before editing source files or adding images, confirm the repo is on a feature branch. If it is on `main`, `master`, `production`, or a release branch, stop and ask to create or switch to a feature branch first.

Inspect the current portfolio page, project grid component, image folders, and any existing project data structures. Then implement the requested project update.

Requirements:

- Follow the existing project card layout and category style.
- Use project images from `public/images` when available.
- Include clear project title, location, category, and descriptive alt text.
- Keep the page responsive on mobile and desktop.
- Do not invent project facts that were not provided.
- Run `npm run build` when feasible.

Finish with what was added or changed and whether the build passed.
